newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan seeks 50,000 T yellow corn for Dec shipment.
newsitem.headline: Jordan seeks 50,000 T yellow corn for Dec shipment.

text.p: Jordan is seeking to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn or better in one lot for shipment in the second half of December under the GSM 102 programme, traders said on Thursday.
They said offers of corn of better grade, or equivalent origin, would also be acceptable.
They said offers must be received by Jordan's Ministry of Supply by November 6. Jordan has an annual consumption of yellow corn of around 400,000 to 500,000 tonnes.
